Has anyone seen this preprint? https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27197

I’d love to take a stab at formalizing it in formal-conjectures if no one else has claimed it!
Seems interesting, I wonder how much infrastructure PhysLib has on electrostatics that we could reuse
I think that could be nice to add indeed! Are there any related open problems in the area? (Or versions of this conjecture that are still open?)

re PhysLib: it does have the single stationary point charge in 3d (Physlib/Electromagnetism/PointParticle/ThreeDimension.lean) with the Coulomb scalar potential, the field, and Maxwell's equations. formal-conjectures only depends on Mathlib anyway.
For continuity of the Zulip thread, @Alex Korbonits just opened this PR: https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4683

To be honest I think I need to revert it to a draft before anyone reviews it but can’t seem to do so on iOS GitHub

Edit: got home and moved to draft. I was a bit hasty on the PR
